Why Waco businesses miss calls

Waco is home to Baylor University, and visitors come for Magnolia Market at the Silos, so food and entertainment employ nearly 12% of workers, one of the highest shares among the Texas cities we cover. Game weekends, graduation and tourist seasons push up call volume at restaurants, hotels and shops. Median household income is lower than most large Texas cities, so a small business here needs to watch every dollar it spends on staffing.

Which Waco businesses benefit most?

  • Restaurants: Answer visitors’ questions about hours and waits during the rush.
  • Auto repair shops: Travelers on I-35 need fast answers when something goes wrong.
  • Medical offices: Patients from surrounding towns can book at any hour.
